titulo.alumno: «Condizionale nella conseguenza»: forming a type II hypothesis

intro: The result of a second-degree hypothesis must always be expressed in the present conditional. Never make the mistake of repeating the subjunctive or of placing the conditional in the condition.

frases.estudio: Se abitassi in centro a Milano, prenderei la metropolitana ogni mattina.
frases.alumno: If I lived in the centre of Milan, I would take the metro every morning.
analisis: if I lived in the centre

frases.estudio: E se studiassi più vicino a casa, risparmieresti molto tempo!
frases.alumno: And if you studied closer to home, you would save a lot of time!
analisis: you would save a lot of time

frases.estudio: È vero. Se avessi una bicicletta, mi muoverei ancora più velocemente.
frases.alumno: That's true. If I had a bicycle, I would move even faster.

texto: **Condition with SE**: imperfect subjunctive (**Se abitassi**, **Se studiassi**).

Look at the examples: **Se abitassi a Roma, prenderei la metro** (if I lived in Rome, I would take the metro); **Se studiassi di più, capiresti meglio** (if you studied more, you would understand better).

filas.texto: If I lived in the centre, I would take the metro.
If you studied methodically, you would understand the concepts.
If I had a bike, I would move faster.

pregunta.texto: In the sentence «Se abitassi a Roma, prenderei la metro», why is «prenderei» in the conditional?

opciones.texto: Because it is the hypothetical consequence that would result if the condition of living in Rome were met.
opciones.explicacion: The apodosis of a type II hypothetical period requires the present conditional.

opciones.texto: Because the verb «prendere» compulsorily takes the conditional for public transport.
opciones.explicacion: It responds to the logical structure of the conditional period, not to the means of transport.

opciones.texto: Because it describes a routine of the past that was repeated every morning.
opciones.explicacion: The imperfect of habit would be «prendevo».

frase.texto: Se tu studiassi con più calma, ___ molto meglio le spiegazioni.

opciones.explicacion: Second person singular of the present conditional of «capire».
It is the informal present indicative.
It is the imperfect subjunctive (it cannot go in the consequence).

frase.texto: Se avessi una bicicletta, mi muoverei ancora più velocemente.

opciones.texto: A desirable improvement in mobility conditional on owning a two-wheeled vehicle.
opciones.explicacion: Protasis with «avessi» and apodosis with «mi muoverei» in the reflexive conditional.

opciones.texto: That the speaker already owns three bicycles and travels by train every day.
opciones.explicacion: It expresses the current lack of a bicycle through «se avessi».

opciones.texto: That traffic in the city is so smooth that no transport at all is needed.
opciones.explicacion: It seeks quick alternatives to get around better.

frase.texto: Se abitassi vicino all'università prenderei la metropolitana ogni giorno

piezas.traduccion: If I lived near the university I would take the metro every day.
piezas.explicacion: Second-degree hypothetical period with the classic order of protasis and apodosis.

pregunta.texto: What syntactic error does the sentence «Se studierei, capirei» contain?

opciones.texto: The improper use of the conditional after the conditional conjunction «se».
opciones.explicacion: After «se» the conditional is never placed in Italian; one must say «se studiassi».

opciones.texto: The lack of agreement in feminine gender with the following adjective.
opciones.explicacion: It is an error in the selection of verb mood in the protasis.

opciones.texto: The absence of an articulated preposition before the verb.
opciones.explicacion: Conjugated verbs do not take an articulated preposition in front.

frase.texto: Se noi avessimo una macchina, ___ a trovare i nonni ogni domenica.

opciones.explicacion: First person plural of the present conditional of «andare».

pregunta.texto: What is the exact meaning of this statement?

frase.texto: Se studiassi di più, capiresti meglio.

opciones.texto: If you studied more, you would understand better.
opciones.explicacion: A type II period that kindly suggests an improvement in performance.

opciones.texto: As you did not study anything yesterday, you failed the exam.
opciones.explicacion: It frames the present situation as constructive advice, not a reproach about the past.

opciones.texto: You study a great deal and therefore understand everything perfectly.
opciones.explicacion: It suggests that the listener currently does not study enough.
